newsitem.title: USA: Dlr/Swiss at 44-month high, rally seen broadening. [CORRECTED 19:38 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Dlr/Swiss at 44-month high, rally seen broadening. [CORRECTED 19:38 GMT]

text.p: The dollar hit a 44-month high at 1.5100 Swiss francs in late U.S. afternoon trade, a signal that the greenback's rally was broadening, traders said.
The mark/Swiss surge on Thursday and dollar/Swiss gains show that the dollar has considerable strength of its own, and was not simply benefitting from a weak mark, dealers said.
"We're making new highs in the Swiss franc and I think we'll see that trend continue," said John Hazelton, chief dealer at Manufacturers and Traders Bank.
The next significant historical peak in dollar/Swiss rests at 1.5125, a high reached in November (corrects from August) 1993.
